name: Chucarosaurus
sum: Chucarosaurus is a large titanosaur from the Albian Huincul Formation of Argentina, known from limb and pelvic bones.
wsnote: The femur is about 1.9 m long, smaller than that of Argentinosaurus (Wikipedia revision).
biology: The forelimb was shorter than the hindlimb, with a humerus 78% the length of the femur.
author: Agnolin et al. 2023

sources.text: Agnolin, Federico L.; Gonzalez Riga, Bernardo J.; Aranciaga Rolando, Alexis M.; Rozadilla, Sebastián; Motta, Matías J.; Chimento, Nicolás R.; Novas, Fernando E. 2023.
